entry.title: Public Tips Help Recover Sutherlin’s Stolen Historic Train Whistle

entry.title: Kickstart Coffee Plans to Open Within the Next Week in Roseburg
entry.summary: Kickstart Coffee plans to open within the next week at 485 NE Stephens Street in Roseburg, the former Oregon Sourdough location. Owner Jace Russell said the menu will feature coffee, energy drinks, soups, paninis, and salads. A grand opening date is to be announced.

entry.title: Roseburg’s Warm October Weather to Give Way to Weekend Highs in the 60s
entry.summary: Roseburg’s warm, dry weather will continue through Thursday, with highs reaching about 85 degrees. A cold front is expected to bring a sharp weekend cooldown, dropping highs into the upper 60s, with little rain expected.

entry.title: Winston Proposes Replacing Fixed Yard-Waste Burning Months With Fire Restriction Standards
entry.summary: Winston is considering replacing its four designated yard-waste burning months with rules based on current fire restrictions. The proposal would allow burning outside those months when permitted, while keeping fire bans, permit requirements, and other safeguards in place.

entry.title: Razor Clam Harvesting Closes Along Entire Oregon Coast
entry.summary: Razor clam harvesting closed along the entire Oregon coast Oct. 2 after testing found elevated domoic acid levels. Mussel harvesting reopened coastwide. Bay clam and crab harvesting remain open.

entry.title: DFPA to Raise Fire Restrictions to Moderate Starting Monday
entry.summary: DFPA will raise public use restrictions to Moderate and industrial fire precautions to Level 2 on Monday, October 5. Rising temperatures and falling humidity are prompting tighter restrictions on mowing, power saw use, and other activities across the Douglas District.
